description:
T3 Code is a minimal web GUI for coding agents.


v0.1.12 · 1092 changes from 226 contributors
- Multi-repository projects. Work across several repositories in one project and thread, including isolated worktrees.
- Workflows (beta). Create and run durable workflows with agents, schedules, webhooks, and human approvals.
- Linked threads (beta). Read threads on linked machines and connect to interact without pairing each machine first.
- Connections map (beta). See how your machines connect and link a machine through another environment.
- MCP sign-in. Sign in to an agent's MCP server directly from its thread warning, including on remote environments.
- Apple Speech. Dictate locally on your Mac using Apple Speech on macOS 26 or later.
- Large file previews. Open large files in full without freezing the file preview.
Plus 949 more bug fixes and performance improvements.
